text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty INC00012345 — high error rate spike detected in eu-west-1, smart-routing fallbacks increasing, 5xx rate ~30% :rotating_light:
annie_oncall: I'm on it. Seeing latency spikes + ~3k 502s in the last 3m. Hosted API and dedicated customers affected.
matt_runtime: looking at runtime logs — a bunch of requests got routed from eu to us-west fallback and then hit ENCODER_MISMATCH / variant validation failures.
sara_sre: can you paste an error fragment?
matt_runtime: here's a repeated error: "ERROR: model_variant_mismatch: requested variant v1-q4 not found on host, fallback to v1-base failed validation"
leo_dns: did a few digs from edge PoPs, seems some POPs still return old A records for eu edge pointing at us-west LB. example: 

; <<>> DiG 9.11.3 <<>> eu.edge.redwood.example
;; ANSWER SECTION:
eu.edge.redwood.example. 3600 IN A 52.23.44.11 ;; us-west LB

ishaan_platform: wait — TTL 3600? we lowered TTL to 60 last week for the canary, not 3600. sounds like some POP caches didn't pick up the change.
annie_oncall: timeline: smartroute fallback mapping change pushed ~1855549000; DNS TTL change earlier, but some edges still using stale rrset -> fallback to wrong region -> variant mismatch.
sara_sre: customer impact — which tenants? any enterprise-reported incidents?
annie_oncall: yes — two enterprise customers reported increased errors and latency, CS started paging us.
matt_runtime: mitigation suggestion: temporarily disable smart-routing for eu so requests stay local and avoid cross-region fallbacks.
ishaan_platform: I can flip the flag now. executing: `/runctl set smartroute.eu.enable false --who=ishaan_platform`
opsbot: Action scheduled: rollback smartroute.eu.enable -> false by ishaan_platform at 1855550300
annie_oncall: also need to prevent routing to an incompatible variant. we should add a safe-fallback mapping that maps unknown -> v1-base but enforces validation.
matt_runtime: patching router code to soft-fail to older variant if requested variant missing. pushing canary now.
leo_dns: submitted CDN flush request (CDN#8791) to force POP refreshes. they acknowledged; estimated <5m for POPs that honor override.
annie_oncall: running quick smoke after flip:
```
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer ***" -d '{"model":"text-chat","input":"hi"}' -i
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
x-redwood-variant: v1-base
```
sara_sre: metrics? errors reduced?
annie_oncall: errors dropped to ~2.5% from 30% after the flag flip. CDN flush still in progress.
matt_runtime: runtime logs cleared the ENCODER_MISMATCH traces. current 1m error rate ~0.8%.
ishaan_platform: note for postmortem: TTL drift, stale edge rrset, and fallback mapping lacked preflight checks. I'll open the doc.
opsbot: PagerDuty INC00012345 acknowledged by annie_oncall.
matt_runtime: immediate action items: 1) confirm CDN fully flushed POPs 2) don't re-enable smartroute until mapping preflight passes 3) add automated variant-availability check in routing path.
annie_oncall: oncall handoff to sara_sre in 30m. I'll keep monitoring and update thread.
sara_sre: thanks — I'll take overnight watch and coordinate customer comms if anything flares.
annie_oncall: status update (15m): CDN reports full POP refresh, edge A records now point to eu LB, errors steady ~0.2%. closing immediate mitigation.
matt_runtime: rolling router change to add variant-compatibility check in 10m.
ishaan_platform: created incident doc at /docs/incidents/1855550000-edge-smartroute-variant-dns-stale.md (will add timeline + logs).
annie_oncall: closing slack thread, will attach log dump and timeline to the postmortem. :white_check_mark:
